programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3

Everyone realizes that the creature has the ability to find food. Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over who will follow the beast to track down food.

programme.desc: Mr Bean is furious with the untidy state of the streets and all the people who drop litter so he goes on a one-man mission to clean up the town. Armed with several bin bags Mr Bean collects all the rubbish and puts up his own ‘No Littering’ signs - which have absolutely no effect. When the police show no interest in his campaign Bean builds a homemade vacuuming contraption causing chaos and mayhem wherever he goes.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean is very scared on a stormy night and even more so when he hears Mrs Wicket screaming from downstairs. Mr Bean investigates and finds the source of the problem...a rat! Mr Bean offers to help Mrs Wicket rid their house of the troublesome rodent. The only problem is the crafty rat is going nowhere fast and is always one step ahead. Mr Bean looks to inspiration from the Pied Piper but fairy stories don’t always have happy endings.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is at the supermarket when he spots a cool fire engine ride – but the security guard makes it clear it’s for little kids only. Not to be deterred, Mr Bean tries everything he can to distract the guard to have his go on the ride. When he finally does get his go, it’s not as good as he thought it would be, especially when a real fire engine has to be called to help Mr Bean!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Mr. Bean gets in a flap when a monster turns up in his cake-mix. The good news, though, is that the monster turns out to be a harmless baby bird. The bad news is that it grows into a huge stork and takes over his home. Bean attempts to return it to the wild, and finds teaching it to fly makes his arms ache.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean receives a delivery of a bunch of flowers for Mrs Wicket, but accidentally runs them over in the his car. He can’t afford to replace them, so he decides to recreate the bunch by taking flowers one by one from anywhere he can - a vase in a café, a wedding bouquet, even from between the teeth of a tango dancer! But will he assemble the bunch and be back in time for Mrs Wicket?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean gets so engrossed playing with Mr Paliwal’s new drone that he doesn’t notice a car thief stealing his car. They quickly jump into Mr Paliwal’s car and use the drone to track the stolen car to the thief’s warehouse hideout. Using the drone, they discover a criminal car-stealing operation – but will they be able to outwit the car thieves using Mr Paliwal’s flying gadget?

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: When the ghost of a small town's founder returns to scare off mayoral candidates, the gang decides to run Velma as mayor to bait the ghost. They quickly discover, however, that Velma lacks the skillset to make her a popular politician!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: The gang travels to Britain in 1843-ish and runs into Scrooge who claims he was attacked by the ghost of his partner Jacob Marley and that three more ghosts are coming. The gang agrees to solve the mystery but Velma wonders if she has more potential than just solving mysteries.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Chased by a raging elephant, Grizzy and the Lemmings are ejected from the cabin and land on a small nearby promontory. One of the rodents finds himself seated upon a throne-shaped boulder. A ray of sunlight illuminates him, and the savannah animals bow down before the Lemming king! But as soon as he leaves his royal seat, his powers disappear. Grizzy grabs the opportunity to plop down on the throne. Upon his orders, the other animals seek to provide him with every comfort, bringing the cabin, television and food closer. But the Lemmings put their feet down.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy is brutally awakened by four Lemmings who are giving a grand percussion concert near the cabin, while the rest of the group dances to the rhythm. The grumpy bear puts an end to the festivities by propelling the Lemmings into the distance. When they land, they discover a magical djembe inside the trunk of a baobab tree. When the percussionists start playing again, the Lemmings and all the other wild animals are possessed by the demon of dance!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: In the midst of a heat wave, Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over the fridge. The rodents want to transform themselves into ice cubes to glide across their super curling ice slide, while Grizzy wishes merely to lie down inside the nice, cool appliance. After literally breaking the fridge in two, the Lemmings discover a container of refrigerant and create a new giant curling sheet in the savannah. But Grizzy has not given up the idea of resting in a cool spot!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy has gone all out for his dinner guest, the she-bear. But just as he is about to kiss her… Vroom! In the middle of a mad car race, the Lemmings wake him up with a jolt! Dragged out of his slumber and swept away upon a vehicle, Grizzy finishes the race in a daze. Not far away, the Lemmings find a mask that can control dreams. Once Grizzy gathers his wits, he wants only to get hold of the object and return to the she-bear of his dreams. But the Lemmings have other dreams, like high-powered racing cars.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy watches a documentary on salmon, whereas the Lemmings want to dance it up in the garage, nightclub style. TV versus music, the sonic war has begun! When a cloud passes overhead, Grizzy realizes that their respective gadgets run on electricity provided by solar panels. No more sun, no more electricity! He devises a plan whereby he will be the only one to access the energy, but the Lemmings have not said their last word!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: A confrontation between Grizzy and the Lemmings leads to a room in the castle tower. The bear accidentally sets off a mechanism and discovers a large medieval magic trunk.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 3
programme.desc: Mr. Bean accidentally creates an amazing new perfume; but who likes it more? Mrs. Wicket or Scrapper?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 3
programme.desc: Mr Bean is on his way to the seaside when the mini runs out of petrol. Undeterred he manages to get a push but for some reason the do-gooders don’t want to push him all the way to the beach! Instead he uses wind power piggy backs on a car transporter and 802harnesses up some horses to try and get to his destination.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 3
programme.desc: Scrapper gives Bean fleas and Bean is forced to call in the pest control person. His flat will take 24 hours to fumigate. Bean begs Mrs. Wicket to let him stay with her. She agrees as long as Bean helps her with cooking cleaning etc. 24 hours later and Bean is desperate to see the back of her. The feeling is mutual. But then Mrs. Wicket starts itching …

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 3
programme.desc: Mr. Bean is out shopping when it starts to rain. Taking refuge in a trendy coffee bar Bean is fascinated both by the brewing machinery and the amount of money people will pay for small cups of coffee! Scenting a fortune to be made Bean opens up his own strange successful coffee bar …

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket gives Mr Bean some money for a hotel so that her Uncle Ron can stay in his flat, but Mr Bean decides to keep the money and hide in his wardrobe overnight. He makes himself comfortable among the clothes, but starts to get hungry as he watches Ron eating, and can’t resist sneaking out. Can Mr Bean keep himself hidden all night, especially when he needs the toilet?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: After a regrettable episode involving his landlady sleepwalking into his room, Mr. Bean suddenly finds himself out on his ear with nowhere to live. Near to tears, he yearns for the cosy familiarity of his old home. A scarecrow and a pair of false teeth come to his rescue.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko - Season 1
programme.desc: Tom is enjoying his bath time while Jerry bathes Tuffy. Tuffy ends up floating off in a bubble and lands in Tom's bath. Jerry throws in all of the bath bombs creating a massive amount of bubbles. In the end, they all work together to get clean.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3
programme.desc: Buff feels left out at a playdate with Snowy and Grundy, and he goes off on his own. But when Banebuggy shows up, Buff needs his friends more than ever!

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: Bibi has some competition with Nightwing’s motorcycle, Nightbike. Always trying to one-up each other, these stunt bikes will need to learn that they’re better when they work together.

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: In this country-inspired music video, Buff the Bat-Truck shows off his strength as he tows the bad guys out of town and lifts the spirits of his fellow Batwheels with his sensitive side, all while protecting the people (and critters) of Gotham.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: Daphne brings the gang to a Victorian murder mystery party, so they can dress up and solve a fake mystery for once. But when an actual Headless Count (DAVID KAYE) starts kidnapping people for real, the gang must stay in character as they tackle the real caper!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: Fred gets a call for help from Chuck Mangum (JOHN VIENER), his daredevil of a best friend, leading the gang on a rescue mission deep in the caverns of an ancient civilization. Once there, they learn of the real mystery: the ghost of the Tribal Warrior that still protects the cavern from outsiders!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over the last spoonful of Yummy. Their brawl is interrupted when they happen upon a full crate of chocolate spread in the garage. The rodents snatch the crate and take off on a drone. The bear catches up with them, mounted on the back of a giant bat, but the cargo falls onto the roof of a sacred Mayan temple that's boobytrapped! When they recover the Yummy, Grizzy and the Lemmings are pursued by a stone giant!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Night has fallen and the solar panels do not generate enough electricity to charge Grizzy's TV. He sees the Lemmings playing with fireflies that could make his panels work, and tries to distract the Lemmings and capture the fireflies.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: After stealing Grizzy's jar of Yummy chocolate spread, the Lemmings propel the bear far from the log cabin. Grizzy lands in a temple where he finds a crystal skull which gives you the power to cause chaos.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: A newly unpacked UV tanning booth holds the place of honor in the middle of the cabin. Grizzy gets it into his head that a classy tan will help him draw the attention of the she-bear he's enamored with. When he opens the box, he discovers that the Lemmings have beat him to it and are already playing beach party inside the bed.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings have turned the entire cabin topsy-turvy to organize medieval jousts with the ranger's fencing gear. Grizzy, who wishes to recover his couch, tries to straighten up, but is driven out by their fencing foils. To retaliate, Grizzy must find a blade equal to the task. He opts for a fine... frozen swordfish!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: A strange object is delivered to the Ranger's cabin: an over-board! It's a latest generation skateboard which levitates above the ground without wheels. The Lemmings immediately try to get their paws on it, but Grizzy also covets the board as a table to set his TV-dinners down on.

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: Specs and Skinny celebrate a brand new arrival to the family: a body lotion that delivers incredible speed to its wearer. Yay Science! The boys quickly include the speed lotion in their morning routine, because testing inventions on yourself is always a good idea. Then it's time to get out there and nab Lamput once and for all. Results are mixed. On the one hand, the zoom oil certainly works. On the other hand, these nerds aren't really used to having a body that can actually do things. Conclusion: the docs still fail, only this time they fail really quickly. At least they get that round the world trip they were dreaming of.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: The Dino Ranchers kick off their epic summer on Dino Island, ready for nonstop adventure with their fearless Uncle Jack! Jon is in awe of his uncle’s daring spirit and is determined to prove he’s just as bold! But on their very first dino-rescue mission, Jon’s efforts to impress him backfire. While Min and Miguel handle the situation with calm skill, Jon’s overzealousness only creates more chaos!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: The Ranchers are thrilled to haul in a crate of sweet, rare Bramble Fruit. There’s one problem: the fruit’s outer shell is too hard to eat! Miguel unveils his latest invention, the Smooth-a-tron, a gadget that turns rock-hard Bramble Fruit into a silky-smooth, delicious drink! The team is moments away from tasting victory when a massive Quetzalcoatlus swoops down and snatches the entire crate!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: When Irma leaves Mr Bean in charge of her knitwear stall, he manages to tip all the jumpers into a muddy puddle. Panicking, he decides to take them all home to clean them in his washing machine. But somehow he ends up shrinking them all, so tries all sorts of ways to stretch them back to their original size before Irma finds out.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Jealous of Mr Paliwal’s new egg-laying chicken, Mr Bean heads off to the local farm to get himself one. But after causing havoc at the coop, he comes home with the wrong chicken – not only will it not lay eggs, but it turns out Mrs Wicket is allergic to feathers so Mr Bean has to keep the chicken well hidden!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean spots a cool remote-controlled car Mr Paliwal is selling at a yard sale, so he sets up a tombola with his own stuff as prizes to raise some cash. He’s raffling off some not very good things from his flat - the star prize however is his green car, so lots of people are buying tickets hoping to win the car. But Mr Bean has rigged the tombola so that the car can’t be won. Will he get away with it?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: When Mr. Bean breaks his favourite Royal mug he discovers there's only one place to buy a replacement: Buckingham Palace, home of the Queen of England. When one of Her Majesty's corgis runs off with his teddy, Bean gives chase through secret tunnels… and gets lost.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Baby lemmings discover they can play spinning top with nuts. Baby Lynx sets out to beat the lemmings at their game by making herself a big spinning top that can destroy the lemmings' spinning tops. The defeated baby lemmings then find a huge stone top, but just as they're about to play with it, Baby Lynx returns and challenges their mega top.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1

But the Baby Lemmings are using all these elements to make increasingly incredible domino courses! When Baby Raccoon discovers this, he just feels they've made a mess of the forest again, and decides to pick it up despite the Baby Lemmings' annoyance.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings discover that an ant convoy marching in formation to a berry bush and back can be turned into a fun game of “conveyor belt” for them. However, their irascible neighbor, Baby Beaver, diverts the convoy so that the ants start transporting his sticks for him instead. When Baby Castor loses control of the ants and finds himself in trouble, the Baby Lemmings come to the rescue with an even more fun game!

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bigfoot pops in for an unexpected visit and Bugs decides it's high time Bigfoot learned a few things regarding etiquette.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Dr. Clovenhoof creates a cloning device and various odd clones of Bugs.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: Fred switches places with Jeff, the tour guide at a history museum, to give him a chance to lead the Gang in solving a mystery. The mystery: a frightening Egyptian crocodile deity is terrorizing the museum. The problem: Fred is instantly jealous of this new guy and sets out to solve the mystery before Jeff can - with the help of Jeff's tour group of children!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Mr. Bean’s landlady is hopping mad on finding molehills on her lovely croquet lawn. Bean looks to get hammered if he does not rid the old lady of the cuddly little half-blind culprit. He fails dismally with his eccentric mole extermination methods and ends up simply taking the pesky rodent for a ride.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4

But when the window cleaner cancels, Mr Bean sees a money-making opportunity and offers to help. He invents his own mobile window-cleaning device which works brilliantly! But rushing around with a long cleaning pole and a wheelie bin full of water might not have been the best idea when everyone’s rushing around.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: When Tom and Jerry break a picture frame on the wall, Rick gives Tom an ultimatum that he's out for good if he breaks one more thing. Despite Tom's earnest response, he breaks something right after Rick leaves to purchase a new frame. Attempting to fix the problem, Tom borrows tools and coveralls from a repair truck nearby but can't stop breaking things in the repair process.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Lemmings have caught a little spider. Her sticky, elastic threads are absolutely perfect for bungee jumping. Grizzy, who has no intention of getting caught in the web, decides to crush the insect. The only problem: he discovers that he has arachnophobia, which is seriously going to complicate the task.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over chocolate-spread jar lids, which they use as chips in a competition to win goodies. Indeed, next to the supermarket are two jackpot-style machines with slots the size of the lids. But more importantly, there's a key to be won that makes you eligible for the grand prize... the giant jar of Yummy on display under a glass cover.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy has prepared himself a TV dinner to eat in front of his favorite series. But his moment of pleasure is abruptly interrupted by unexplained static. Grizzy rapidly discovers that the true interference is the Lemmings, who are using the TV antenna as a diving board for their water games.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: When he realizes that his beloved she-bear adores the smell of flowers, Grizzy decides to offer her the geraniums that decorate the window ledges of the ranger's cabin. programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power - Season 1

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: Music Meister is stealing the singing voices of all the people in Gotham. Now it's up to bashful Buff to gain confidence in his voice and use it to take down Music Meister.

programme.desc: Chef Poyung Panda hires The Looney Builders to build her a Dim Sum bus in China. The crew faces a major setback and Bugs worries about letting down his favorite chef.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: As The Looney Builders build a giant claw game for Chibi Critter’s arcade in Japan, they discover the claw part is broken.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: The Looney Builders rush to build a soccer stadium in Mexico for their fast customer, Speedy Gonzalez.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders: Hard Hat Time - Season 1
programme.desc: Porky tries to eat his sandwich but keeps getting interrupted by the crew who need his help.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2

The police are alerted but Bean’s main concern is to get some money and get back to the baker’s before all the cakes are sold.

When the police show no interest in his campaign Bean builds a homemade vacuuming contraption causing chaos and mayhem wherever he goes.

But just as he’s about to finish it, Scrapper sniffs out some nearby sandwiches and causes havoc. In the confusion, Mr Bean thinks the cat has swallowed the rudder of his toy boat, so has to capture him and take him to the vet. Will he get his rudder back in time for the race?

But when he sees that they are also showing an action movie – Zombie Aliens 3 – he finds a way to sneak out and into the other screen. But will he get past the usher, and what will happen when Irma notices?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: A confrontation between Grizzy and the Lemmings leads to a room in the castle tower. The bear accidentally sets off a mechanism and discovers a large medieval magic trunk.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: When the Lemmings spoil Grizzy's meal with their new game, the bear evicts them far from the cabin.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings are holding a log throwing competition that stops short when Grizzy sends them soaring into the distance.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over the TV remote control.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings have a whale of a time revamping the paintings on display in the castle by painting themselves alongside the illustrated noblemen.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings improvise a trampoline with bagpipes, only each jump is accompanied by a deafening outburst. Grizzy steps in and hurls the object far from the castle. The Lemmings return to the castle with five sets of enchanted pipes and catapult Grizzy far away. It's his turn to discover the mysterious isle.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3

programme.desc: While fighting over a jelly cake, Grizzy banishes the Lemmings to the castle dungeons and the rodents discover a passageway leading to a secret elfin room.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings take Polaroid snapshots of themselves disguised outside the castle along with a sheep who poses with them.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: With a ring that lets their astral bodies travel, the Lemmings decide to haunt Grizzy.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over a giant jelly cake. Their chase leads them to the castle library, where the Lemmings accidentally activate the opening of a secret passage.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover a card that enables them to teleport a magic closet.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings have fun bouncing off the backs of green frogs while Grizzy chases some mosquitos buzzing around him. Displeased, the rodents replace Grizzy's green frogs with poisonous orange ones that paralyze anyone who touches them!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy comes home and discovers the Lemmings dancing madly and throws them into the jungle where they meet a parrot that can reproduce any sound. The bird becomes their ally to distract Grizzy and recover their musical equipment.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is at a farmers’ market with Irma at her knitwear stall – right next to a man selling novelty teapots. Bean is instantly smitten with a green car-shaped one but can’t afford it. When he visits a food truck that’s laid out free samples, he hatches a plan to swipe them and sell them on his own stall so he can raise the cash for the teapot of his dreams!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is watching Clint Chiseljaw - his favourite action TV show - with Billy, but Mrs Wicket orders her nephew downstairs to finish his chores. programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4

programme.title: Moley - Season 1

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: When Molieres travelling spectacular comes to MoleTown, it brings with it, a rather unique guest, which soon becomes very attached to Dotty.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: When Moley finds an old Movie poster about a human hero, Manny's magic conjours up an entire world of action and adventure.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry - Season 1

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 1

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 1

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 1

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: After a series of beatings from Tom, Jerry storms off into his mouse hole. Soon he falls asleep and dreams himself to be the Lord of Downton Abbey! Tom is caught in the act of exacting revenge, so Lord Jerry challenges Tom to a duel in the dream world.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Jerry is feeling lonely and wishes he had a girlfriend. Spike explains spring fever to Tom and they leave him be. Jerry's mood improves when he gets a message from his brawny cousin Muscles, who has fixed him up with his girlfriend's friend for a double date.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3

Tom pursues the cunning, feisty bumpkins, and Jerry, throughout the manor, and they delight in making surprise appearances to Tom in awkward moments.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: In a trunk, Grizzy and the Lemmings discover a big chocolate egg with a surprise inside. They are licking their lips. Not intimidated, Grizzy and the Lemmings decide to get their hands on it, but the entire bird colony intervenes.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1

The team is moments away from tasting victory when a massive Quetzalcoatlus swoops down and snatches the entire crate!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Baby Moose loves to frolic in fields of flowers! What he doesn't like, however, are the bees that gather pollen in them. But the baby lemmings get dirty immediately! Baby Raccoon decides to teach them some manners!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Further to a misunderstanding, Grizzy is persuaded that the she-bear he's in love with has been turned into a frog. Whilst he looks through the ranger's books of fairytales, searching for a means to return his beloved to her original form, the Lemmings try to recover the frog, with whom they have so much fun playing rodeo games.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy discovers a baby raccoon not far from the log cabin. When he sees its big moist eyes, Grizzy melts and adopts the creature. When the Lemmings drag the baby into their dangerous games, the overprotective Grizzy steps in, provoking even more perilous situations!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: By pure chance, Grizzy discovers the pleasures of video games on the ranger's console. The Lemmings want to try their hand at the joystick but Grizzy refuses to interrupt his Kart racing game. They try everything, including temptation, to get him away from the console but there's nothing doing, Grizzy is addicted.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy builds a look-alike robot to keep the Lemmings away while he prepares a popcorn party for his beloved she-bear. But his double¿s artificial intelligence truly leaves to be desired. If only it were as clever as the original...

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: When she is accidentally hit over the head, the she-bear Grizzy¿s in love thinks she¿s a Lemming. Grizzy thinks that another little well-placed bang over the head will knock her ideas back into place. The only problem is that the Lemmings, who are delighted to have a new playmate, have no intention of letting him proceed with his plan.

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power - Season 1
programme.desc: Mia and Kai have to infiltrate Enigma’s base, taken over by the villains, to get it back and access the super computer.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: When Batwing's favorite Bat-Net gets ripped during a chase with Riddler, she must learn to let go of her old net (despite it being her favorite) if she's going to help Batman stop the Riddler in his tracks.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: Clayface, Gotham City's messiest villain, arrives to cause trouble during Gotham's annual Clean Up Day. Redbird must overcome his fear of taking baths if he's going to help Bam bring Clayface to justice.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: Buff makes a wish on a magic artifact for the other Batwheels to be turned into monster trucks, just like him! The rest of the Batwheels must learn how to use their big new bodies to undo the wish!

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: Bibi just can’t put down her new exciting video game, even when MOE needs her help packing Bam’s utility belt for a mission. Can she overcome the enticing distraction to save the day when Bam’s mis-packed belt goes haywire?

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2
programme.desc: The Looney Builders are hired by Ma and Pa Bear to build a bedroom for their son, Junior, whose excitement causes setbacks.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2
programme.desc: When The Looney Builders help Wile E. Coyote build a telescope to view the Looney Moon, Tweety must face his fear of the dark.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2
programme.desc: Gossamer invites The Looney Builders on a camping trip. They plan to build a simple campsite until Daffy insists they go “glamping” instead.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2
programme.desc: The Looney Builders build Marvin the Martian and his Martian crew a space station. Marvin soon becomes overwhelmed by his Martian crew’s antics and lack of personal space.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders: Hard Hat Time - Season 1
programme.desc: Daffy invites the crew to take a mud soak in his truck bed and it turns out to be anything but relaxing.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean is very scared on a stormy night and even more so when he hears Mrs Wicket screaming from downstairs. Mr Bean investigates and finds the source of the problem...a rat! Mr Bean offers to help Mrs Wicket rid their house of the troublesome rodent. The only problem is the crafty rat is going nowhere fast and is always one step ahead. Mr Bean looks to inspiration from the Pied Piper but fairy stories don’t always have happy endings.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean decides to do something romantic on Valentine’s Day for his long-suffering girlfriend Irma. But while he is secretly delivering her valentines card Mr Bean finds out he has a love rival for Irma’s attention. Bean steps up his efforts and takes Irma on a ‘date’ to the Valentine’s Fair only to find his love rival is there too! But will the fortune-teller’s prediction be the ticket to a happy ending?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: When a TV show offers cash to film in haunted homes, Mr Bean invites a film crew over and rigs his flat up to make it as spooky as possible – wobbly picture frames on wires, eerie noises on a tape recorder and a good old-fashioned sheet for a ghost. But will the tricks be convincing enough to win Mr Bean the money?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean offers to repair Mrs Wicket’s antique necklace, but when his back is turned Scrapper gets entangled and runs off with it around his neck. Mr Bean turns his flat upside before spotting the bejewelled cat and gives chase. But when Mrs Wicket sees Mr Bean’s abandoned flat in a mess, she thinks her necklace has been stolen by a burglar!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings organize an obstacle course in their cabin. Grizzy ejects the Lemmings from the cabin and they crash onto an Incan temple where they discover a spheric object that can control the Earth's rotation.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings get hold of an old pinball machine and install it in the cabin. Their furious party interrupts Grizzy's nap and the bear threatens to break the contraption.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy, a big chocolate lover, is growing a young cacao tree under an ultraviolet lamp. During a trampoline session, the Lemmings accidentally break the lamp, provoking a supernatural reaction.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: During a fight, Grizzy and the Lemmings stumble upon a Mayan temple lost in the jungle. Once inside, they set off a magic reaction that creates doubles of themselves at different ages.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Short on food supplies, Grizzy has gone out to gather fruit. He comes back with a basketful but discovers that the Lemmings have stolen the last helping of Yummy chocolate spread in the cabin. A fight breaks out.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings take off with the last jar of Yummy chocolate spread. Grizzy catches up with them but they drop the jar and it lands in a nearby sacred temple. While trying to get inside, they accidentally activate a mechanism that blocks the entrance. Grizzy and the Lemmings must resolve riddles and overcome dangerous obstacles along the path to the Yummy – before the other one gets there first!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings organize wrestling combats on the living room couch. Grizzy, weary of the clamor, stops the match. The displeased Lemmings retaliate, but during their fight the cabin's wood floor caves in and they all fall into an old sidecar with four wrestling masks inside. Grizzy, two Lemmings and a partridge launch into a pitiless combat.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: After a spat over a jar of Yummy, Grizzy and the Lemmings find gold leaf-wrapped chocolate bits scattered in the jungle. Delicious! On the backs of a bat and a tapir, the rodents and the bear fight over the harvest of candy.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over the last spoonful of Yummy. Their brawl is interrupted when they happen upon a full crate of chocolate spread in the garage. The rodents snatch the crate and take off on a drone. The bear catches up with them, mounted on the back of a giant bat, but the cargo falls onto the roof of a sacred Mayan temple that's boobytrapped! When they recover the Yummy, Grizzy and the Lemmings are pursued by a stone giant!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Night has fallen and the solar panels do not generate enough electricity to charge Grizzy's TV. He sees the Lemmings playing with fireflies that could make his panels work, and tries to distract the Lemmings and capture the fireflies.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: After stealing Grizzy's jar of Yummy chocolate spread, the Lemmings propel the bear far from the log cabin. Grizzy lands in a temple where he finds a crystal skull which gives you the power to cause chaos.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: While climbing back to the cabin carrying a load of delicious berries, Grizzy trips and falls over backwards. He performs a series of acrobatics worthy of a diving champ and resurfaces safe and sound despite himself. The Lemmings, who saw everything, are in awe and treat Grizzy like an idol. Grizzy starts to enjoy this VIP treatment until the Lemmings ask him to repeat his exploit. Grizzy agrees but discovers that the Lemmings have built a giant diving board for the occasion.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings lose their jar of chocolate spread in a labyrinthian Temple. Determined to recover their favorite afternoon snack, they confront one another in the maze, but end up getting totally lost. Grizzy finds himself back at square one and decides to find something to make holes in the walls and cheat. As for the Lemmings, they discover a magic map of the place that enables you to orient yourself and modify the corridors in real time. Which cheater will win?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Things start to disappear from the log cabin as if by magic. Grizzy is persuaded that the Lemmings are the culprits, but the Lemmings are also victims of inexplicable thefts. As they argue, Grizzy and the Lemmings discover the true authors of the repeated thefts: a gang of fanatic partridges who bring stolen objects as offerings to their goddess, a giant partridge. Grizzy and Lemmings join forces to infiltrate the nest and recover their belongings.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: A frog swallows an ancestral jewel that bestows it with the power of mind control. Grizzy uses the frog to swallow the flies that have proliferated in the cabin, and which now let themselves be docilely caught. The Lemmings don’t miss a thing. They decide to get hold of the frog to hypnotize an uncooperative tapir who refuses to play rodeo. Grizzy hypnotizes the Lemmings, who become his servants. But several Lemmings escaped and are preparing a rescue mission.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is bored of queuing for a trampoline park, so secretly bounces in through a window using a trampette. But he soon gets on the wrong side of a young show-off boy who keeps stealing Teddy and throwing him in hard-to-reach spots. To settle their row, they agree on a race around the trampoline park – first place wins Teddy. Will Mr Bean triumph before he’s chucked out for jumping the queue?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Irma is struggling to sell items from her knitwear stall at the market, so sends Mr Bean to collect a sheep costume he can wear to attract customers. Once at the fancy dress shop however, Mr Bean gets stuck in the sheep costume and has to travel back to the market wearing it. Things go from bad to worse when Mr Bean takes a short cut across the field and gets caught up in a flock of real sheep!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean spots a rare book - the Teddy Bear Haunting - in a bookshop, but it’s too expensive to buy. He secretly tries to read it in the shop… until he’s thrown out. To his dismay someone else then buys the book – so he follows the buyer around trying to read over his shoulder. Will Mr Bean manage to get to the end of the book before getting spotted?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy are enjoying a day at the arcade, when Mr Bean gets carried away with the dance machine, knocking Teddy onto the floor. Teddy’s picked up, put on a trolley of stuffed toys and figurines – and soon enough, he’s been put in the claw machine as a prize! Mr Bean has run out of coins, so has to find a way of winning Teddy back without looking like he’s cheating!

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko - Season 1
programme.desc: Jerry sneaks into the party set up to steal some cheese while Tom is sleeping. Tom wakes up and chases Jerry across a table filled with all kinds of food. During the chase, Tom eats a melon which turns him into a sphere shape and Jerry eats a piece of cheese which turns him into a triangle shape.

programme.title: Diena po rytojaus

Niujorke temperatūra per vieną dieną svyruoja nuo kaitros iki stingdančio speigo. Netikėti staigūs klimato pokyčiai visame pasaulyje sukelia neregėto masto kataklizmus – žemės drebėjimus, milžiniškas potvynių bangas. Profesorius Edrienas Holas tyrinėja klimato pokyčius, kuriuos sukėlė pragaištingas „šiltnamio reiškinys“. Be to, jis privalo surasti ir išgelbėti savo sūnų, kartu su draugais įkalintą milžinišku ledo miestu virtusiame Niujorke. Prasidėjus nevaldomam visuotiniam bėgimui, herojus iškeliauja ten, iš kur visi trokšta kuo greičiau ištrūkti – į bekraštes ledo ir sniego platybes, netikėtai nusidriekusias ten, kur dar neseniai stūksojo modernūs didmiesčiai...

programme.title: Pilietinis karas
programme.desc: Jungtinėse Amerikos Valstijose siaučia nevaldomas pilietinis karas. Nepasitenkinimą valdžia reiškianti visuomenė nebeturi ko prarasti ir imasi drastiškų veiksmų. Keturių patyrusių Niujorko žurnalistų komanda nutaria keliauti į Vašingtoną. Jų tikslas – paimti interviu iš autoritariniu diktatoriumi virtusio šalies prezidento (akt. Nick Offerman). Jau tris kadencijas iš eilės valdantis prezidentas jaučia artėjančią grėsmę, o jo vadovaujamos specialiosios pajėgos desperatiškai bando išlaikyti kontrolę. Žurnalistų kelionė tampa tikru išbandymu. Karo fotografė Li (akt. Kirsten Dunst), jos kolega žurnalistas Džoelis (akt. Wagner Moura), veteranas reporteris Semis (akt, Stephen McKinley Henderson) ir jauna, tik ką pradėjusi dirbti fotografė Džesė (akt. Cailee Spaeny) stengiasi likti neutraliais stebėtojais. Bet kiekvieną kelionės akimirką jiems tenka susidurti su kankinimais, masinėmis kapavietėmis, nevaldomu smurtu ir šalį niokojančia agresija. Nepaisydami pavojaus, fiksuodami įvykius, žurnalistai tęsia kelionę ir pasiekia Baltuosius rūmus. Visuotinio šturmo metu į susišaudymą patekusi Li žūsta, o jos kolegos tampa įsiveržimo į Ovalųjį kabinetą liudininkais. Prieš pat kariams įvykdant egzekuciją, Džoelis sustabdo juos, kad gautų paskutiniąją prezidento citatą.

Pilotuoti lėktuvą išmokęs vos 15-os metų, devintajame praėjusio amžiaus dešimtmetyje Baris buvo vienas geriausių aviakompanijos TWA lakūnų. Būtent tuomet jį užverbavo CŽV, tikėdamasi panaudoti savo operacijose prieš Centrinės Amerikos šalyse stiprėjančias komunistų organizacijas.Tačiau tikrovė pranoko visus lūkesčius. Tačiau staiga oro uostą užgrobia ginkluoti asmenys, siekiantys išvaduoti stambų prekeivį narkotikais ir išgabenti jį į Karibus. programme.title: Išėjimo nėra
programme.desc: Reabilitacijos centre besigydanti Darbė trokšta tik vieno, - kuo greičiau pasprukti. Vos pasitaikius progai, jauna mergina pabėga nuo prižiūrėtojų ir vogtu automobiliu patraukia į gimtinę. Darbė skuba aplankyti sergančią motiną, bet užklupus pūgai keliai tampa nepravažiuojami. Nelieka nieko kito, kaip apsistoti atokioje kalnų poilsio aikštelės trobelėje ir laukti kol stichija nurims. Trobelėje Darbė susipažįsta su keturiais nelaimėliais, kurie dėl snygio taip pat buvo priversti nutraukti keliones. Matydama, kad su nepažįstamaisiais teks praleisti ne vieną valandą, mergina desperatiškai trokšta paskambinti mamai ir nuraminti ją, bet telefono signalas neveikia. Išėjusi į kiemą patikrinti mobiliojo ryšio stiprumo, Darbė netikėtai išgirsta keistus garsus. Viename iš aikštelėje stovinčių automobilių, mergina aptinka siaubo apimtą, pagrobtą vaiką. Dabar Darbė turi sukaupti visą drąsą ir sumanumą. Ji privalo išsiaiškinti, kuris iš nepažįstamųjų yra pagrobėjas. Ar išlaisvinusi mergaitę ji sugebės pasirūpinti jos saugumu? Galbūt name laukiantys žmonės yra susimokę ir visi stos prieš nekaltą vaiką ir Darbę?

programme.title: Teaduspauk
programme.desc: Teadus-mustkunstnik Eric jagab saladusi teaduse, tehnoloogia, inseneriteaduse ja matemaatika maailmast, et õpetada lastele, kuidas üllatada oma sõpru ja perekonda STEM-põhiste võlutrikkide ja käsitööga! Kujutage ette, et saate teha telefonile kõlarid vaid mõnest tavalisest majapidamises kasutatavast esemest või luua kõrgelennulise raketi pudeli, sooda ja veega. See kõik on võimalik läbi teaduse jõu!

programme.title: Ahne aju
programme.desc: Lõbus sari, mis süveneb meie maailma põnevatesse avastustesse, täis huvitavaid fakte ajaloo, teaduse, spordi, moe, isetegemise, retseptide, loomade ja maagia kohta.

programme.title: Matapauk
programme.desc: Eric Leclerc on matemaatik ja otsekui mustkunstnik näitab ta meile kui müstiliselt huvitav on matemaatika, mis peidab end kõikjal meie ümber. Matapauk õpetab väga lõbusal ja huvitaval kombel meid kõiki matemaatikat armastama.

programme.title: Hiiglaslikud teaduskatsed
programme.desc: Mis saab siis, kui tavalisest teaduskatsest teha midagi tõeliselt suurt? Suur läbikukkumine? Või hoopis ülipõnev ja kohutavalt lõbus etendus?

programme.title: Ajurünnak
programme.desc: Oled sa kunagi mõelnud, kas ilma tiibadeta on võimalik lennata? Või kõndida mööda vesiliiva? Kaks last esitavad võimatuna näiva väljakutse ning sukelduvad koos saatejuhtidega teadusmaailma.

programme.title: Noored kangelased
programme.desc: Põnev sari, kus lapsed võistlevad kahes suures väljakutses, mis on inspireeritud tõestisündinud kangelasteost.

programme.title: Andy eelajaloolised seiklused
programme.desc: Andy töötab muuseumis ning tema kasutada on ajamasin, mis viib ta tagasi eelajaloolisse aega, et ta saaks sealt kaasa tuua sulgi, luid ja kõike muud, mida muuseumi ekspositsioon vajab. Tänu oma seljakotis olevatele vajalikele abivahenditele jõuab ta alati ohutult tänapäeva muuseumi tagasi.

programme.title: Imeline Planeet
programme.desc: Selles kaasahaaravas teadussarjas avastab Jacques Cousteau kõige imelisemaid paiku Maa peal, Maa sees ja Maa kohal. Uskumatud rännakud meie imelise planeedi kõrgeimate mägede tippudest kuni sügavaimate paikadeni ookeanides.

programme.title: Andy reisiseiklused
programme.desc: Andy, Jen ja Scout reisivad oma keskkonnasõbraliku masinaga mööda maailma ja avastavad looduse saladusi ning loomade uskumatut käitumist.

programme.title: Matapauk
programme.desc: Eric Leclerc on matemaatik ja otsekui mustkunstnik näitab ta meile kui müstiliselt huvitav on matemaatika, mis peidab end kõikjal meie ümber. Matapauk õpetab väga lõbusal ja huvitaval kombel meid kõiki matemaatikat armastama.

programme.title: Vägevad masinad
programme.desc: Mootorrattur Grace istub juhiistmel ja tutvustab publikule maailma suurimaid, kiiremaid ja vägevamaid masinaid.

programme.title: Meister igal alal
programme.desc: Kümme noorsportlast osalevad ülimal spordivõistlusel. Trikk on aga selles, et nad ei võistle oma spordialadel, vaid teiste võistlejate aladel. Võistluse lõpus enim punkte kogunud sportlane pälvib tiitli Meister igal alal.

programme.title: Lahedad loomad
programme.desc: Alates surfavatest hiirtest ja maalivatest koertest kuni rääkivate hobuste ning trühvlisigadeni. Kõige kavalamad, nunnumad ja pöörasemad loomad.

programme.title: Andy safari seiklused
programme.desc: Andy töötab Safari maailmas, kogu Maakera kõige suuremas ja paremas looduspargis koos oma ülemuse, härra Hammondi ja tehnikavõluri Jeniga. Mistahes huvitav ülesanne teda ees ka ei ootaks, kihutab Andy oma safari-autoga kohale.

programme.title: Joonistame koos
programme.desc: Maailmakuulsate Marveli, Ämblikmehe ja Tähesõdade koomiksiraamatute kunstnik Will Sliney näitab, kuidas joonistada tegelasi maailma tuntumatest multikatest, nagu näiteks „Käsna-Kalle Kantpüks“, „Vali maja“, „Boss Beebi“, „Käpapatrull“ ja paljud teised.

programme.title: Andy veeseiklused
programme.desc: Andy naaseb vaimustavate veeseiklustega. Avasta temaga koos veekogusid üle kogu maakera ning kohtu delfiinide, vaalade ja muude hämmastavate loomadega.

programme.title: Namas prie jūros
programme.desc: Anos dukra Holė turi naują vaikiną – Džo. Holei atvykus pas mamą, paaiškėja, kad Ana ir Džo jaunystėje susitikinėjo. Tačiau apie tai pamena tik Ana, Džo, regis, viską seniai pamiršo.

programme.title: Meilei nėra recepto
programme.desc: Darbšti ir maloni visiems aplinkiniams Paz Roble patiria siaubingą vyro išdavystę. Prasiskolinęs sutuoktinis vietoj išpirkos nusprendžia skolininkams atiduoti savo naujagimę dukrą. Dukrelės netekusi Paz nebegali rasti sielos ramybės ir nusprendžia visą savo laiką skirti dingusios mažylės paieškoms. Šeimos restoranas, kuriame Paz ilgus metus darbavosi, dėl skolų ir sutuoktinių barnių dabar stovi užkaltais langais.Sėkmingas verslininkas Estebanas Vila de Cortesas netikėtai tampa našliu. Mirus žmonai vyras lieka su trimis vaikais ir dideliu skausmu širdyje. Dar blogiau, kad jo anyta Elvira laiko jį kaltu dėl savo dukros mirties. Moteris dega keršto troškimu ir tikisi sužlugdyti Estebaną.Netikėta Paz ir Estebano pažintis vėl uždega abiejų širdyse viltį ir tikėjimą. Estebanas pasiūlo jai darbuotis jo namų virtuvėje. Paz nedvejodama sutinka su šiuo pasiūlymu, nes nieko kito taip nesiilgėjo, kaip vėl gaminti mylimiems žmonėms.Ar Estebano ir Paz jausmai atlaikys jų šeimų keliamus iššūkius? Kaip į Paz reaguos kerštingoji Elvira? Ar Estebanas sugebės apsaugoti mylimąją? Ar jis padės atrasti jai prarastą dukrą?

programme.title: Mano mažasis karalius
programme.desc: Aleksas ir Inesa gyvena įprastą gyvenimą. Rytais skuba į mokyklą, o grįžę namo po pamokų bando prasimanyti pramogų. Tačiau vieną dieną rutina sprogsta į šipulius, nes namuose jie patinka liūto jauniklį. Tą patį vakarą visos šalies žiniasklaidos priemonės rėkte rėkia, kad pervežimo metu ir vietos oro uosto paspruko liūto jauniklis. Paskelbiama aukščiausio lygio paieška. Vaikai negali susitaikyti su tuo, kad nuostabus liūtukas bus uždarytas narve. Aleksas ir Inesa nusprendžia grąžinti gyvūną į jo namus Afrikoje. Pasiekti kitą žemyną ne taip paprasta, tad į pagalba jie pasikviečia savo senelį Maksą. Vos porą kartų matytas senolis yra tikras keliauninkas ir priima vaiku kvietimą. Pavojų kupina kelionė prasideda.

programme.title: Angelas sargas
programme.desc: Šivradžas ir Rasal – vienas kitą mylintys brolis ir sesuo. Netekę mylimos mamos, vaikai užgauliojami bendraamžių ir engiami kaimynų. Brolis jaučia didelę atsakomybę apsaugoti mažąją sesutę, tad tampa tikru apsaugos skydu kasdieniuose iššūkiuose. Gyvenimas pasisuka dramatiškai, kai vaiku tėvas patenka į avariją ir susiduria su paslaptingos ginkluotos grupuotės nariais. Dabar vaikams teks dar labiau saugoti vienam kitą. Ar meilė ir ištikimybė padės išlikti kartu klastinguose gyvenimo posūkiuose? Ar blogo linkintys niekšai palauš vaikų pasitikėjimą vienas kitu?

programme.title: Be namų
programme.desc: Serialas sukurtas remiantis Daivos Vaitkevičiūtės apysaka „Trise prieš mafiją“, kuri 2006 m. pripažinta „Metų knyga“ paauglių kategorijoje ir yra leidžiama vis naujais tiražais. „Be namų“ – tai gyvenimiška drama, kurioje susipina jautrūs vaikų likimai, detektyvinės mįslės bei nuoširdi draugystė, lydima įkvepiančių svajonių, linksmų ir šiurpių nuotykių. Serialo centre – vaikų globos namų auklėtinė Emilija ir jos draugai – našlaitis, pravarde Kobė, ir Kasparas. Šio tėvai mįslingai dingsta. Veiksmas rutuliojasi mažame Lietuvos miestelyje, kuriame daug saulės, bet mažai meilės. Vietinių globos namų auklėtiniai kasdien susiduria ne tik su geraširde direktore ir rūpestingu ūkvedžiu, bet ir su žiauria auklėtoja.

programme.title: Kažkas tave myli
programme.desc: Vyrui žuvus avarijoje, Karlota viena augina dukrą Linėją ir uždirba pragyvenimui sukdamasi savo kavinukėje. Jos verslo partneriai Astrida ir Johanas taip pat prisideda visomis išgalėmis, kad įmonė klestėtų. Našle tapusi Karlota nedrąsiai užmezga naujus santykius, o išdrįsusi, labai greitai patiria išdavystę. Netrukus po to, kai ją išdavė mylimasis Gustavas, moteris pradeda gauti meilės prisipažinimų pilnus laiškus ir atvirukus. Karlota niekaip negali suprasti, kas jai siunčia romantiškas žinutes. Galbūt Gustavas jaučia nežmonišką kaltę ir taip bando susitaikyti? Negalėdama matyti nežinioje besiblaškančios mamos, Linėja prisipažįsta, kad šiai nežinant, ji užregistravo mamą pažinčių svetainėje „Švedijos širdys“. Dabar bet kuris vyras, užkalbinęs Karlotą, jos mintyse traktuojamas, kaip tas romantiškas nepažįstamasis. Kas siunčia gėles ir meilės žodžius? Ar paaiškėjus tiesiai, Karlota pripažins, kad meilės toli ieškoti nereikia?

programme.title: Gero vakaro šou
programme.desc: Nestokojant puikaus humoro čia kalbinami žymūs Lietuvos žmonės, netikėtais kampais atskleidžiant jų portretus, skamba gyvo garso pasirodymai, laidos svečiai atlieka netikėčiausias užduotis.

programme.title: Moterų laimė
programme.desc: „Moterų laimės“ pirmasis sezonas pasakojo apie buvusią namų šeimininkę, vienišą mamą ir tris jaunas, nepatyrusias merginas, kurios ėmėsi bendro verslo ir dėl to nuolat kovojo su gyvenimo negandomis. Šią vasarą „Moterų laimės“ pagrindinė istorija suksis apie vieną heroję – aštuoniolikmetę Mildą, užaugusią vaikų namuose ir netikėtai atsidūrusią sostinėje. Milda – drąsi, nebijanti pakovoti už save, tačiau gyvenimas Vilniuje bus visai ne toks, kokio ji tikėjosi. Čia jos lauks susitikimas su biologine mama, nelegalus darbas... Herojė ne savo noru įsivels į kriminalinę veiklą, o šis jos biografijos šešėlis tikrai nepadės ateityje – nei karjeroje, nei meilėje. Į šią istoriją įsivels ne tik jaunas perspektyvus verslininkas, bet ir pagiežingas, herojei į tėvus tinkantis vyras. Tiesa, jų tikslai bus labai skirtingi...

programme.title: Ieškant dukros
programme.desc: Žiaurų likimo smūgį patyrusi Hidžran niekaip negali susitaikyti su kūdikio praradimu. Mintys apie gimdymo metu mirusią dukrelę lydi moterį kiekviename žingsnyje. Nors gydytojai ligoninėje teigė, kad kūdikis neišgyveno, Hidžran nuojauta kužda ką kita. Troškimas sutikti dukrelę dega jaunos moters širdyje ir suteikia jėgų gyventi.Vieną dieną Hidžran pamato šalikelje stovinčiame automobilyje dūstančią mergaitę. Moteris nelieka abejinga ir puola gelbėti mažylę. Nepaisydama savo saugumo, ji sugeba ištraukti negaluojančią mergaitę iš automobilio. Deja, netrukus pasirodžiusiam jos tėvui Emre ši situacija pasirodo labiau panaši į vaiko pagrobimą, nei į norą padėti. Hidžran sulaikoma ir ilgai tardoma dėl šio incidento. Laimei, peržiūrėję gatvę filmuojančių vaizdo kamerų įrašus, pareigūnai išleidžia Hidžran į laisvę. Mažosios Melek tėvas privalo atsiprašyti geraširdės moters. Jis puikiai supranta, kad tik Hidžran dėka jo mažoji dukrelė vis dar gyva.Sužinojęs, kad Hidžran ieško darbo, Emre nedvejodamas pasiūlo jai dirbti prabangiuose savo namuose ir būti Melek aukle. Mergina sutinka ir apsigyvena Melek šeimos dvare. Nuo pat pirmos akimirkos auklė pakliūva į siautulingą intrigų liūną. Šeimą skaldo dramatiškos paslaptys, kova dėl valdžios ir chaosas. Tačiau dabar visi likimo smūgiai tampa pakeliami, nes Melek ir Hidžran turi viena kitą. Mergaitės ir jos auklės tandemą apgaubia pasitikėjimo, pagarbos ir meilės skydas, nors jos net nenutuokia, kad yra motina ir dukra.

programme.title: Kažkas tave myli
programme.desc: Vyrui žuvus avarijoje, Karlota viena augina dukrą Linėją ir uždirba pragyvenimui sukdamasi savo kavinukėje. Jos verslo partneriai Astrida ir Johanas taip pat prisideda visomis išgalėmis, kad įmonė klestėtų. Našle tapusi Karlota nedrąsiai užmezga naujus santykius, o išdrįsusi, labai greitai patiria išdavystę. Netrukus po to, kai ją išdavė mylimasis Gustavas, moteris pradeda gauti meilės prisipažinimų pilnus laiškus ir atvirukus. Karlota niekaip negali suprasti, kas jai siunčia romantiškas žinutes. Galbūt Gustavas jaučia nežmonišką kaltę ir taip bando susitaikyti? Negalėdama matyti nežinioje besiblaškančios mamos, Linėja prisipažįsta, kad šiai nežinant, ji užregistravo mamą pažinčių svetainėje „Švedijos širdys“. Dabar bet kuris vyras, užkalbinęs Karlotą, jos mintyse traktuojamas, kaip tas romantiškas nepažįstamasis. Kas siunčia gėles ir meilės žodžius? Ar paaiškėjus tiesiai, Karlota pripažins, kad meilės toli ieškoti nereikia?

programme.title: Meilei nėra recepto
programme.desc: Darbšti ir maloni visiems aplinkiniams Paz Roble patiria siaubingą vyro išdavystę. Prasiskolinęs sutuoktinis vietoj išpirkos nusprendžia skolininkams atiduoti savo naujagimę dukrą. Dukrelės netekusi Paz nebegali rasti sielos ramybės ir nusprendžia visą savo laiką skirti dingusios mažylės paieškoms. Šeimos restoranas, kuriame Paz ilgus metus darbavosi, dėl skolų ir sutuoktinių barnių dabar stovi užkaltais langais.Sėkmingas verslininkas Estebanas Vila de Cortesas netikėtai tampa našliu. Mirus žmonai vyras lieka su trimis vaikais ir dideliu skausmu širdyje. Dar blogiau, kad jo anyta Elvira laiko jį kaltu dėl savo dukros mirties. Moteris dega keršto troškimu ir tikisi sužlugdyti Estebaną.Netikėta Paz ir Estebano pažintis vėl uždega abiejų širdyse viltį ir tikėjimą. Estebanas pasiūlo jai darbuotis jo namų virtuvėje. Paz nedvejodama sutinka su šiuo pasiūlymu, nes nieko kito taip nesiilgėjo, kaip vėl gaminti mylimiems žmonėms.Ar Estebano ir Paz jausmai atlaikys jų šeimų keliamus iššūkius? Kaip į Paz reaguos kerštingoji Elvira? Ar Estebanas sugebės apsaugoti mylimąją? Ar jis padės atrasti jai prarastą dukrą?

programme.title: Angelas sargas
programme.desc: Šivradžas ir Rasal – vienas kitą mylintys brolis ir sesuo. Netekę mylimos mamos, vaikai užgauliojami bendraamžių ir engiami kaimynų. Brolis jaučia didelę atsakomybę apsaugoti mažąją sesutę, tad tampa tikru apsaugos skydu kasdieniuose iššūkiuose. Gyvenimas pasisuka dramatiškai, kai vaiku tėvas patenka į avariją ir susiduria su paslaptingos ginkluotos grupuotės nariais. Dabar vaikams teks dar labiau saugoti vienam kitą. programme.title: Be namų
programme.desc: Serialas sukurtas remiantis Daivos Vaitkevičiūtės apysaka „Trise prieš mafiją“, kuri 2006 m. pripažinta „Metų knyga“ paauglių kategorijoje ir yra leidžiama vis naujais tiražais. „Be namų“ – tai gyvenimiška drama, kurioje susipina jautrūs vaikų likimai, detektyvinės mįslės bei nuoširdi draugystė, lydima įkvepiančių svajonių, linksmų ir šiurpių nuotykių. Serialo centre – vaikų globos namų auklėtinė Emilija ir jos draugai – našlaitis, pravarde Kobė, ir Kasparas. Šio tėvai mįslingai dingsta. Veiksmas rutuliojasi mažame Lietuvos miestelyje, kuriame daug saulės, bet mažai meilės. Vietinių globos namų auklėtiniai kasdien susiduria ne tik su geraširde direktore ir rūpestingu ūkvedžiu, bet ir su žiauria auklėtoja.

programme.title: Autorius ir aš
programme.desc: Vestuvinių prekių parduotuvei vadovaujanti Eba verčiasi ir vasarnamių nuoma. Atostogų namelį išsinuomoja žavus rašytojas Rasmusas, kuris prie jūros tikisi ramiai pabaigti rašomą romaną. Rasmusas toli gražu nespinduliuoja draugiškumu ir Ebai kelia nemažai problemų. Viskas pasikeičia, kai išsikalbėjus paaiškėja, kad jie abu yra Biancos Lund meilės romanų gerbėjai. Ši bendrystė suartina Ebą ir Rasmusą. Pabaigęs rankraštį, romanistas visą laiką praleidžia su žavinga vasarnamio nuomotoja. Ebos draugė Livė nerimauja, kad jos sužadėtinis visiškai nesidomi vestuvių planavimu. O bičiulė Tildė susiginčija su Rasmusą lankančiu leidėju Svenu. Ginčo metu paaiškėja, kad jauna autorė Lilit Holm savo debiutiniame romane panaudojo didelę Biankos Lund romano dalį. Kas tiksliai nuo ko nukopijavo tekstą? Kaip baigsis Livės vestuvių pasiruošimas? Ar Rasmusas ir Eba bendraus pasibaigus vasarai?

programme.title: Gero vakaro šou
programme.desc: Nestokojant puikaus humoro čia kalbinami žymūs Lietuvos žmonės, netikėtais kampais atskleidžiant jų portretus, skamba gyvo garso pasirodymai, laidos svečiai atlieka netikėčiausias užduotis.

programme.title: Moterų laimė
programme.desc: „Moterų laimės“ pirmasis sezonas pasakojo apie buvusią namų šeimininkę, vienišą mamą ir tris jaunas, nepatyrusias merginas, kurios ėmėsi bendro verslo ir dėl to nuolat kovojo su gyvenimo negandomis. Šią vasarą „Moterų laimės“ pagrindinė istorija suksis apie vieną heroję – aštuoniolikmetę Mildą, užaugusią vaikų namuose ir netikėtai atsidūrusią sostinėje. Milda – drąsi, nebijanti pakovoti už save, tačiau gyvenimas Vilniuje bus visai ne toks, kokio ji tikėjosi. Čia jos lauks susitikimas su biologine mama, nelegalus darbas... Herojė ne savo noru įsivels į kriminalinę veiklą, o šis jos biografijos šešėlis tikrai nepadės ateityje – nei karjeroje, nei meilėje. Į šią istoriją įsivels ne tik jaunas perspektyvus verslininkas, bet ir pagiežingas, herojei į tėvus tinkantis vyras. Tiesa, jų tikslai bus labai skirtingi...

programme.title: Ieškant dukros
programme.desc: Žiaurų likimo smūgį patyrusi Hidžran niekaip negali susitaikyti su kūdikio praradimu. Mintys apie gimdymo metu mirusią dukrelę lydi moterį kiekviename žingsnyje. Nors gydytojai ligoninėje teigė, kad kūdikis neišgyveno, Hidžran nuojauta kužda ką kita. Troškimas sutikti dukrelę dega jaunos moters širdyje ir suteikia jėgų gyventi.Vieną dieną Hidžran pamato šalikelje stovinčiame automobilyje dūstančią mergaitę. Moteris nelieka abejinga ir puola gelbėti mažylę. Nepaisydama savo saugumo, ji sugeba ištraukti negaluojančią mergaitę iš automobilio. Deja, netrukus pasirodžiusiam jos tėvui Emre ši situacija pasirodo labiau panaši į vaiko pagrobimą, nei į norą padėti. Hidžran sulaikoma ir ilgai tardoma dėl šio incidento. Laimei, peržiūrėję gatvę filmuojančių vaizdo kamerų įrašus, pareigūnai išleidžia Hidžran į laisvę. Mažosios Melek tėvas privalo atsiprašyti geraširdės moters. Jis puikiai supranta, kad tik Hidžran dėka jo mažoji dukrelė vis dar gyva.Sužinojęs, kad Hidžran ieško darbo, Emre nedvejodamas pasiūlo jai dirbti prabangiuose savo namuose ir būti Melek aukle. Mergina sutinka ir apsigyvena Melek šeimos dvare. Nuo pat pirmos akimirkos auklė pakliūva į siautulingą intrigų liūną. Šeimą skaldo dramatiškos paslaptys, kova dėl valdžios ir chaosas. Tačiau dabar visi likimo smūgiai tampa pakeliami, nes Melek ir Hidžran turi viena kitą. Mergaitės ir jos auklės tandemą apgaubia pasitikėjimo, pagarbos ir meilės skydas, nors jos net nenutuokia, kad yra motina ir dukra.
